title: Settings
description: The school's rules live here. A change applies at once and reaches draft payroll runs only; approved runs never change.

school.title: School
school.description: Name, language, working hours and days

structure.title: School structure
structure.description: Stages such as Kindergarten and Primary

hrRules.title: HR rules
hrRules.description: Lateness, day value, part-time pay, repeat window

catalogue.title: Penalty catalogue
catalogue.description: Violations and what each repeat costs

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: The payroll tax rule: income-tax slices, the martyrs' fund and the insurance share.

save.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: Your changes in this section haven't been saved. Leaving now discards them.

errors.time: Choose a time on the hour or half hour.
errors.workHoursOrder: Work end must be after work start.
errors.workingDays: Choose at least one working day.
errors.days: Use quarter days from 0 to 30, like 0.25, 0.5 or 1.25.
errors.divisor: Enter a whole number from 1 to 31.
errors.percent: Enter a whole percentage from 1 to 100.
errors.stepsMin: Keep at least one hour step.
errors.rate: Enter a rate from 0 to 99.99, with up to 2 decimals.
errors.bracketPlusFund: This rate plus the martyrs' fund must stay under 100%.

school.defaultLanguageHint: What the sign-in page and new visitors see first.

logo.title: School logo
logo.description: Shown in the menu, on the sign-in page and on payslips. PNG, JPG or SVG, up to {max} MB.
logo.current: This is the logo in use.
logo.none: No logo yet. The app shows a plain mark until you upload one.
logo.ready: Preview of {name}. Upload it to use it everywhere.

problems.type: Only PNG, JPG or SVG files can be used.
problems.size: The file must be {max} MB or smaller.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Hidden stages stay on the employees who have them but can't be chosen for new ones. Stages are never deleted.
stages.emptyBody: Add the school's first stage, such as Primary.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Hide a department to stop new employees joining it. Departments are never deleted.
departments.emptyBody: Add the first department, such as Mathematics.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.description: Hide a job title to stop new employees getting it. Job titles are never deleted.
jobTitles.emptyBody: Add the first job title, such as Teacher.
jobTitles.managesPeopleHint: People with this job title can be chosen as a direct manager.

lateness.title: Lateness rule
lateness.description: A month's late arrival and early leave minutes are added up, then turned into days of pay.
lateness.graceHint: Taken off the month's total before the hour steps apply.
lateness.extraHint: The cost of every hour after the last step.
lateness.stepsHint: Any minutes inside an hour count as that hour: 1–60 minutes is the 1st hour. The days add up.

example.label: Example:
example.enterMinutes: Enter minutes to see the days they cost.
example.invalidRule: Fix the rule above to see an example.

payroll.title: Payroll rule
payroll.description: How a day of pay and part-time salaries are worked out.
payroll.divisorHint: A day of pay is the month's salary divided by this number.
payroll.partTimeHint: Part-time staff are paid this share of their basic salary.

penalties.title: Penalty repeats
penalties.description: How far back the system looks when it counts a repeated violation.

catalogue.retireGroupBody: Every violation in this group stops being available for new penalties. Penalties already recorded are kept. You can restore the group later.
catalogue.groupRetiredNote: This group is retired, so its violations can't be used for new penalties. Restore the group to use them again.
catalogue.noViolations: No violations in this group yet.
catalogue.emptyBody: Add a group, then the violations it holds.
catalogue.noteHint: Kept as written, e.g. "doubles on repeat". The system doesn't apply it on its own.
catalogue.oncePerDayHint: When on, an employee can get this violation at most once on the same date. Turn it off for violations that can happen several times a day, like being late to class.
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: Search by violation or group, in English or Arabic
catalogue.noMatchesBody: Try another word, or clear the search to see the whole catalogue.
catalogue.levelsHint: The 1st to the {max}th time it happens ({min} to {max} levels). After the last level, the last one repeats.

problems.NUMBERING: Levels must be numbered 1 to 5 with no gaps.
problems.DAYS_INVALID: Use quarter days above 0 and up to 30, like 0.25, 1 or 1.5.

tax.title: Tax and insurance
tax.description: Salaries are net: when HR approves a month, accounting works out the income tax, martyrs' fund and insurance share the school pays on top of what each employee is paid.
tax.bracketsHint: Taxable pay is taxed slice by slice: the first slice at its rate, the next slice at the next rate, and so on. The last slice covers the rest.
tax.restHint: Everything above the slices before it.
tax.martyrHint: A share of the gross, paid by the school.
tax.insuranceHint: A share of the insured salary, for insured employees only.

example.line: net {net} → income tax {tax} · martyrs' fund {fund} · gross {gross}
example.enterNet: Enter a net amount to see its tax.
example.invalidRule: Fix the tax rule above to see an example.
example.hint: For an employee who isn't insured. An insured employee's share is added to the gross.
